data.long_meaning: One who is born under a star, victorious one. The name Tarique carries the meaning “Star, Victor” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi, Urdu. Parents who choose Tarique usually hope their child will grow to embody star, victor and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.cultural_impact: The name Tarique has its roots deeply embedded in Islamic culture where Тарик (Tarique) is the Arabic name which means 'born under a star'. However, the name has gained popularity in the Hindu community due to its resonance with the culturally rich Indian tradition of astrology and astronomy. In Hindu astrology, the stars are believed to exert an influence on one's personality and destiny. Therefore, the name Tarique carries a sense of divine presence and can be seen as a symbol of good fortune and destiny.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Tarique signifies the inner light that shines within each individual, born under the guidance and protection of the celestial bodies. It can be seen as a reminder of the divine connection between the individual self and the cosmos, emphasizing the importance of staying in tune with the universal energies and aspiring towards enlightenment.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Tarique: Radiant beacon, guiding light in the spiritual journey. The name signifies one who illuminates the path to self-realization with wisdom and compassion.
